title: Dedicated generated-artifact evidence workflow for Production promotions

phases.objective: Register a uniquely named pull-request workflow for exact same-repository promotions targeting Production while retaining the existing read-only work-branch evaluator, one canonical evidence contract, and the separately governed writer.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository pull request is opened, synchronized, or reopened with base Production
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: GitHub schedules the uniquely named Protected Promotion Generated Artifact Refresh workflow, which evaluates the exact source head, publishes the canonical generated-artifact report, and performs no repository mutation.
steps: Exclude Production-target pull requests from the existing work-branch generated-artifact workflow.
Register a distinct workflow file and unique display name whose pull_request branch filter targets Production without path filtering.
Require a same-repository head and reject bot recursion.
Validate the exact source SHA, target ref, and Production base before checkout.
Checkout the exact source head without persisted credentials.
Verify local and remote exact-head identity.
Run publisher, mutation-boundary, generation, and verification regressions in the ephemeral runner.
Upload mad4b.pr-generated-artifact-refresh-summary.v1 evidence before enforcing its decision.
Route both generated-artifact workflow names through the trusted publisher into the same canonical evidence section.
assertions: The work-branch evaluator declares branches-ignore for Production and retains the name PR Generated Artifact Refresh.
The protected-promotion evaluator declares the unique name Protected Promotion Generated Artifact Refresh, branches Production, and no workflow_dispatch trigger.
Both evaluators retain contents read permission, persist-credentials false, and no git push.
CI Evidence PR Publisher listens to both names and downloads the same canonical artifact shape.
Machine routing registers both names as aliases of mad4b.pr-generated-artifact-refresh-summary.v1.
The governed writer remains workflow-dispatch-only and rejects main and Production.
The generated-artifact report remains read-only with commit_sha null and repository_mutation_performed false.
No migration, SQL execution, deployment, provider call, credential access, external send, protected-branch mutation, or force push occurs.

phases.objective: Observe canonical evidence publication on an exact main-to-Production promotion after the uniquely named workflow reaches both governed branches.
Exercise stale source heads, missing remote refs, cross-repository heads, cancelled superseded runs, alias-routing mismatch, and canonical artifact upload failures without repository writes.
Verify unique workflow registration and canonical PR comment replacement on a controlled Production promotion candidate.
Require successful exact-head generated-artifact evidence before every protected Production promotion merge.
